exposure: Hereditary Angioedema (HAE) due to C1-inhibitor (C1INH) deficiency (C1INH-HAE)
cohort: 87 women with Hereditary Angioedema (HAE) due to C1-inhibitor deficiency (C1INH-HAE) who experienced at least one pregnancy
finding: Most C1INH-HAE women undergo successful pregnancy and delivery with appropriate management and counseling.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more prevalent in the group treated with pdC1INH.
